Feature: Lab and Patient Interaction

  Scenario: Lab requests are routed to the Laboratory
  Given a patient with a valid pincode
  When the lab request is submitted
  Then the request should be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario: Lab personnel make appointments
  Given a lab personnel
  When they make an appointment
  Then they should be able to perform home collection of specimen

  Scenario: Lab personnel send reports
  Given a lab personnel
  When they send a report
  Then they should send it to the patient directly

  Scenario: Patient uploads reports
  Given a patient
  When they upload reports
  Then they should be able to upload up to 5 reports per consultation

  Scenario: Consultation request routing
  Given a patient
  When they request a consultation
  Then the request should be routed to a doctor of a speciality

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm assistance
  Given a doctor
  When they use the machine learning algorithm
  Then they should be able to predict diseases based on symptoms

  Scenario: Diagnosis acceptance
  Given a doctor
  When they receive a diagnosis
  Then they should be able to accept or modify the diagnosis

  Scenario: Diagnosis responsibility
  Given a doctor
  When they perform a diagnosis
  Then the responsibility should be with the doctor


Examples:
